title: Deploying with CI/CD, IaC and Containers

header.html: Use Lambda deployment packaging methods (3.3.1); deploy containerized applications with ECS, EKS and Fargate (3.3.2); use infrastructure as code templates (3.3.3); deploy revisions with CodeDeploy (3.3.4); orchestrate pipelines with CodePipeline (3.3.5); implement deployment strategies (3.3.6); implement rollback (3.3.7); use source control features (3.3.8); use AWS AI tools in CI/CD (3.3.9)
the official AWS Developer Associate (DVA-C03) exam guide, Task 3.3

html:
1The CI/CD services

Service Role
AWS CodePipeline Orchestrates the stages: source, build, test, approval, deploy
AWS CodeBuild Builds and tests code in managed containers; defined by buildspec.yml
AWS CodeDeploy Deploys revisions to EC2, on-premises servers, Lambda and ECS; defined by appspec
AWS CodeArtifact Package repository for dependencies

buildspec.yml phases: install, pre_build, build, post_build, plus artifacts and cache. CodePipeline passes artifacts between stages through S3, and can include a manual approval action.

2CodeDeploy

Compute How it deploys
EC2 or on-premises In-place (stop, install, start) or blue/green; AppSpec hooks: BeforeInstall, AfterInstall, ApplicationStart, ValidateService
Lambda Shifts traffic between versions with an alias: canary, linear or all at once
ECS Blue/green with a load balancer shifting traffic to a new task set

Automatic rollback can be triggered by failed deployment or a CloudWatch alarm.

Exam tip

. Gradual Lambda release with automatic rollback = CodeDeploy with an alias and a canary or linear configuration plus alarms.

3Deployment strategies

Strategy Behavior Risk
All at once Replace everything now Downtime, fast, hard rollback
Rolling Update batches Reduced capacity during the update
Rolling with additional batch Add new capacity first Keeps full capacity, costs more
Immutable Launch new instances, swap Safe, easy rollback, uses more capacity
Blue/green Two environments, switch traffic Fast cutover and rollback, double cost during the switch
Canary Small share of users first Limits blast radius
Linear Shift traffic in equal steps Predictable, slower

4Infrastructure as code

Tool What it is
AWS CloudFormation JSON or YAML templates that create stacks; change sets preview changes; automatic rollback on failure; drift detection
AWS SAM Extension of CloudFormation for serverless: a short AWS::Serverless syntax, sam build, sam deploy
AWS CDK Define infrastructure in a programming language; synthesizes CloudFormation
Exam tip

. "Preview what a template update will change" = change set. Stack creation failure rolls back by default.

5Containers and source control

Topic What to know
Amazon ECS Run containers from a task definition; Fargate (no servers) or EC2 launch type; services do rolling updates or blue/green
Amazon EKS Managed Kubernetes; deploy manifests (Deployments, Services)
Lambda packaging .zip, container image, layers (Module 11)
Source control Branches per environment or feature, tags and labels for releases, pull requests for review
AI in CI/CD Automated approvals, environment provisioning and post-deployment validation can use AI tools [Verify live]; keep human approval for production
Exam tip

. CodePipeline orchestrates, CodeBuild builds, CodeDeploy deploys. Know which verb belongs to which service.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A team wants a pipeline that builds, tests and deploys on every commit. Which service orchestrates the stages?

  • AAWS KMS
  • BAWS CodePipeline
  • CAmazon SQS
  • DAmazon EBS
Show the answer

Answer: B. CodePipeline orchestrates source, build, test and deploy stages.

S2Which file tells CodeBuild what commands to run?

  • ADockerfile only
  • Bbuildspec.yml
  • Cpolicy.json
  • Dcron.txt
Show the answer

Answer: B. The buildspec defines CodeBuild's phases and artifacts.

S3A team releases a Lambda update to 10 percent of traffic first and rolls back if an alarm fires. What fits?

  • ACodeDeploy canary deployment with an alias and an alarm
  • BDeleting the old version
  • CAn all-at-once deployment
  • DA larger memory size
Show the answer

Answer: A. CodeDeploy shifts alias traffic gradually with automatic rollback on alarms.

S4Which strategy launches new instances and swaps them in, making rollback easy?

  • AAll at once
  • BImmutable
  • CRolling with no extra capacity
  • DIn-place
Show the answer

Answer: B. Immutable deployments use fresh instances and are easy to roll back.

S5A team wants to see what a CloudFormation update will change before applying it. What should they create?

  • AA new stack in another account
  • BA Lambda layer
  • CA dead-letter queue
  • DA change set
Show the answer

Answer: D. Change sets preview stack changes.

S6A team wants serverless resources in a short template syntax. Which tool fits?

  • AAmazon Route 53
  • BAWS CodeArtifact
  • CAmazon ElastiCache
  • DAWS SAM
Show the answer

Answer: D. SAM extends CloudFormation for serverless.

S7A containerized app should run without managing servers. Which ECS launch type fits?

  • AEC2 launch type
  • BAWS Fargate
  • CSpot Fleet
  • DSnowball
Show the answer

Answer: B. Fargate runs containers without managing instances.

6.2 Recall questions

R1Which service orchestrates a CI/CD pipeline?

Show the answer

AWS CodePipeline.

R2What are the buildspec phases?

Show the answer

Install, pre_build, build and post_build.

R3Name two Lambda traffic-shifting configurations.

Show the answer

Canary and linear (or all at once).

R4What is a CloudFormation change set?

Show the answer

A preview of the changes an update would make.

R5What does SAM stand for?

Show the answer

Serverless Application Model.

R6What does CDK do?

Show the answer

Defines infrastructure in a programming language and synthesizes CloudFormation.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
CI/CD CodePipeline orchestrates; CodeBuild (buildspec); CodeDeploy (appspec); approvals
Strategies all at once, rolling, rolling + batch, immutable, blue/green, canary, linear
IaC CloudFormation (change sets, rollback, drift), SAM (serverless), CDK (code)
Containers ECS (task definition, Fargate), EKS (manifests)
Rollback CloudFormation automatic; CodeDeploy on failure or alarm
